stock.title: Stock
stock.lead: The bins on the warehouse floor and what each holds. Book deliveries in for the merchant who sells the product, correct counts when goods are damaged or missing, and read back every movement.
stock.list.title: Bins by code
stock.list.empty: No bin exists yet. Create one before booking goods in.
stock.idle.title: Nothing chosen
stock.idle.body: Choose a bin to see what is on it, book goods in or adjust a count. Or find where a SKU is kept.
stock.finder.label: Find a SKU
stock.finder.placeholder: SKU, exactly as catalog has it
stock.finder.title: Where {sku} is kept
stock.detail.emptyShelf: Nothing has been booked into this bin yet.
stock.ledger.title: Ledger
stock.receive.title: Book goods into {bin}
stock.receive.body: Look the SKU up in catalog first: the goods are booked for the merchant who sells it.
stock.receive.notOnSale: No product with this SKU is on sale.
stock.receive.noMerchant: Catalog names no merchant for this product, so it cannot be booked.
stock.receive.noteHint: Optional, at most 1000 characters: the delivery, the carton, who brought it.
stock.adjust.title: Adjust {sku} in {bin}
stock.adjust.body: {onHand} on hand, {reserved} held for orders: at most {free} can be taken away.
stock.adjust.noOwner: This stock names no merchant, so warehouse will not adjust it: book it in again for its merchant first.
stock.bin.codeHint: At most 64 characters, as printed on the label. It cannot be changed later.
stock.rule.code: Give the bin a code of at most 64 characters.
stock.rule.zone: Give the bin a zone of at most 64 characters.
stock.rule.sku: Give a SKU of at most 128 characters.
stock.rule.removal: At most {free} can be taken away now.
stock.done.replayed: That delivery was already booked into {bin}; nothing was booked twice: {onHand} on hand.
stock.failure.wrongOwner: This bin already holds that SKU for another merchant. Book the goods into another bin.
stock.failure.reserved: That would cut into units held for orders. At most {max} can be taken away now.
stock.failure.noOwner: This stock names no merchant. Book it in again for its merchant before adjusting it.
stock.failure.keyConflict: Warehouse already recorded a different movement under this request's key. The form now has a new key: check the shelf, then send it again if it is still needed.
stock.failure.limit: The bin cannot count that many units of this SKU. Book the rest into another bin.
stock.failure.unknownMerchant: Identity knows no merchant with that principal, so nothing was booked.
stock.failure.noBin: This bin no longer exists. The list has been read again.
stock.failure.refused: Warehouse refused the request; nothing was changed.
stock.failure.unsure: Warehouse did not give a final answer, so whether it was recorded is not known. Send it again: the same request is booked once.
